translated_text: November 29, 11:40 AM. My dear, I'm sending you the two packages you asked for today. I hope this is what you ordered. I ordered Feford paper, 500% sheets, that's 50% iron. It's terribly expensive, so be careful (59.90 for a box of 100 sheets, 13.18). Bichal didn't call me today. Maybe tomorrow. I received them. They are a bit annoying. I have her photo, isn't that really what you can do this morning? The pretty card. Send me everything that's not bad. I had a big discussion with Mom today. She's really too sensitive. I can't stand her sometimes. I suggested she go live on Rue du Lieuvin if she finds life too difficult with me. That's all for today. Kisses and love you more and more. - of Baba. 81 PUCINE TRY YOUR LUCK 10 PARIS 1 81 6 PM MAY 40 exporthal CHAN E NAVGINALE Robert Zweigenthal MALE Vel Rota 1st Czechoslovak Regiment Pezenas Hérault #81 JA T TA AN
